description: This file defines the Zend_Loader_PluginLoader class, which manages loading and caching of plugin classes in the Zend Framework. It includes methods for adding/removing prefix paths, loading classes, and managing a class file cache.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_PluginLoader
classes.description: A class for dynamically loading plugin classes with support for prefix paths, static registry, and class file caching.

methods.name: addPrefixPath
methods.description: Adds a prefix and path to the registry for plugin class loading.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves registered paths for a given prefix or all prefixes.

methods.name: clearPaths
methods.description: Clears registered paths for a given prefix or all prefixes.

methods.name: removePrefixPath
methods.description: Removes a prefix and optionally a specific path from the registry.

methods.name: _formatName
methods.description: Normalizes plugin class names by capitalizing the first letter.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a plugin by a specific name is already loaded.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the full class name for a plugin if loaded.

methods.name: getClassPath
methods.description: Returns the file path to the plugin class.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a plugin class by name, including searching paths and including the class file.

methods.name: setIncludeFileCache
methods.description: Sets the file path for caching include_once statements for plugin classes.

methods.name: getIncludeFileCache
methods.description: Retrieves the current include file cache path.

methods.name: _appendIncFile
methods.description: Appends an include_once statement to the class file cache.
